sources.note: Indexed official release checked; direct fetch failed. Marshall/Warren, Perth, Helicobacter pylori and gastritis/peptic ulcer disease. No current treatment advice or claim all ulcers have one cause.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia: National Apology
sources.note: 13 February 2008 apology for forced child removal; Stolen Generations and continuing impact.

sources.note: 1945 assisted migration,1947 displaced Baltic migrants and racial preference, later diversification; Harry Duyker work boots 1973 to 1985. Do not adopt erroneous claim these were the first non-British immigrants.
